# useLongPress

> Press-and-hold detection for pointer and keyboard, returned as props to spread.

🟡 intermediate · React 16.8+ · Custom Hooks › Timing & scheduling · support: universal

**Playground:** `npm run dev` → [`#/entry/use-long-press`](http://localhost:5173/#/entry/use-long-press)

## Concept

Pointer down (primary button/touch/pen) or holding Space/Enter starts a timer; it fires `onLongPress` after `threshold` ms. Moving beyond `moveTolerance`, leaving, `pointercancel`, releasing early or blurring cancels.

## Problem

Mouse/touch-only implementations exclude keyboard users, fire after the finger slid away to scroll, open the mobile context menu, and leak timers on unmount.

## When to use

- Hold-to-confirm destructive actions, revealing secondary actions on touch, press-and-hold repeat triggers.

## When not to use

- As the only way to do something — WCAG 2.5.1 requires a single-pointer alternative; offer a menu or confirm dialog too.
- Drag gestures — use a gesture library (e.g. @use-gesture) that handles pointer capture and velocity.

## API

```ts
function useLongPress<T extends Element = Element>(
  onLongPress: (event: PointerEvent<T> | KeyboardEvent<T>) => void,
  options?: {
    threshold?: number;
    moveTolerance?: number;
    keyboard?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    onStart?;
    onCancel?;
    onFinish?;
  },
): LongPressHandlers<T>;
```

| Parameter                                            | Type              | Description                                                                            |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `onLongPress`                                        | `(event) => void` | Called once when the threshold is reached.                                             |
| `options.threshold` _(optional)_                     | `number`          | Hold time in ms (default 500).                                                         |
| `options.moveTolerance` _(optional)_                 | `number`          | Pixels of movement allowed (default 10).                                               |
| `options.keyboard` _(optional)_                      | `boolean`         | Support holding Space/Enter (default true).                                            |
| `options.onStart / onCancel / onFinish` _(optional)_ | `(event) => void` | Lifecycle callbacks (cancel = released before the threshold, finish = released after). |

**Returns:** Stable props: `onPointerDown/Move/Up/Leave/Cancel`, `onKeyDown/Up`, `onBlur`, `onContextMenu`.

## Edge cases

- A short press still produces a normal `click`; keep the primary action on `onClick`.
- Key repeat (`event.repeat`) is ignored; only the key that started the press ends it.
- The context menu is suppressed only while a press is active.
- A new pointer down ends a press that never received its pointer up (e.g. the element was replaced).

## Browser support

Uses Pointer Events (all modern browsers).
